title.purpose: Story heading and param values, Nunito.

label.purpose: Story chips, units, pads, skip link at 0.6875rem.

shadows.name: knob-inset-ring
shadows.purpose: 1px ink box on the knob hit; not a drop shadow.

motion.name: glyph-field
motion.value: 1200ms interval, 0.35 phase delta; pause when hidden, off-screen, still/reduce atmosphere, or prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
motion.purpose: Glacial ASCII weather behind the operated hit.

motion.name: wisp-drift
motion.value: 48s ease-in-out closed path translate3d; none when still, reduce, or prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
motion.purpose: Ribbon haze over the glyph field; no 48s sawtooth jump.

motion.name: hit-ack
motion.value: 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) color-only; 80ms when reduce; rotor transform none
motion.purpose: Acknowledge hover/latch without interpolating analog drag.

breakpoints.name: coarse-pointer
breakpoints.purpose: Story chips and overlay keep 2.75rem min-height; extra inline padding.

breakpoints.name: fine-hover
breakpoints.purpose: Mute invert on rest chips, pads, and steppers.

components.name: Story chip
components.description: Bracketed catalog story at rest: 1px mute box on fog, 44px min-height.
components.css: .ds-story-chip { font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #2f3438); background: var(--bg, #eef1f4); border: 1px solid var(--muted, #5a6570); border-radius: 0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-story-chip:hover { background: var(--muted, #5a6570); color: var(--bg, #eef1f4); } .ds-story-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Story chip current
components.description: Open story: moss fill, fog type; aria-current only.
components.css: .ds-story-chip-current { font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bg, #eef1f4); background: var(--accent, #4f6458); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4f6458); border-radius: 0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-story-chip-current:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pad
components.css: .ds-pad { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); border-radius: 0; background: var(--bg, #eef1f4); color: var(--ink, #2f3438); font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pad:hover { background: var(--muted, #5a6570); color: var(--bg, #eef1f4); } .ds-pad:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pad pressed
components.description: Latched pad: moss fill, fog glyph.
components.css: .ds-pad-pressed { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); border-radius: 0; background: var(--accent, #4f6458); color: var(--bg, #eef1f4); font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pad-pressed:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stepper button
components.description: 2.75rem square 1px box; pair sits under param chrome.
components.css: .ds-stepper-btn { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; min-width: 2.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); border-radius: 0; background: var(--bg, #eef1f4); color: var(--ink, #2f3438); font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stepper-btn:hover { background: var(--muted, #5a6570); color: var(--bg, #eef1f4); } .ds-stepper-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nameplate
components.description: 1px ink box; model at value size, caption muted.
components.css: .ds-nameplate { display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.35rem 0.45rem 0.45rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #2f3438); background: var(--page, #eef1f4); font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nameplate-model { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nameplate-caption { color: var(--muted, #5a6570); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Overlay toggle
components.description: Same chip language as stories; inspect-only, Surface and plates.
components.css: .ds-overlay-toggle { font-family: Nunito, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #2f3438); background: var(--bg, #eef1f4); border: 1px solid var(--muted, #5a6570); border-radius: 0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-overlay-toggle[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--accent, #4f6458); color: var(--bg, #eef1f4); } .ds-overlay-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Knob hit
components.description: Square ink box with square moss rotor; kit default 40px / 108px dial.
components.css: .ds-knob-hit { position: relative; width: 108px; height: 108px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface, #eef1f4); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink, #2f3438); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-knob-hit:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-knob-rotor { width: 12%; height: 42%; border-radius: 0; background: var(--accent, #4f6458); position: absolute; bottom: 50%; left: 44%; transform-origin: 50% 100%; transform: rotate(-40deg); }

components.name: Slider
components.css: .ds-slider-hit { width: 9rem; min-width: 3.5rem; height: 1.5rem; min-height: 1.5rem; background: transparent; display: flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slider-track { width: 100%; height: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); background: var(--page, #eef1f4); overflow: hidden; } .ds-slider-fill { width: 35%; height: 100%; background: var(--accent, #4f6458); } .ds-slider-hit:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #2f3438); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Aether’s catalog is a full-bleed mist field, not a card stack and not a phosphor terminal. Fog is the ground. Charcoal is the ink. Moss is latched-on. Tone is sparse glyph density on a slow ASCII veil sitting behind a single hit. Each kit control is its own story; Seto opens one, operates it, then opens Prism · Hold as another story.

Kit tokens and hits are the family language. Catalog chrome is the inspector veil; it is not a Van de Graaf carrier. Surfaces still place widgets with a Van de Graaf construction derived from the plate size.
keyCharacteristics: Nunito chrome, Italianno live, VT323 only in the field
Slow ASCII veil; paused when hidden or reduced-motion
1px ink boxes; square rotors; moss invert on latch and current story
44px minimum on chips, pads, and steppers
Overlay as inspect-only paint on Surface and plates

rules.name: The Veil Rule
rules.body: Grey in the field is sparse glyph density on mist, never a phosphor hex.

rules.name: The Latch Rule
rules.body: Rest chrome is ink on fog. Moss is function: current story and latched-on.

rules.name: The Three-Face Rule
rules.body: Nunito for operate chrome. Italianno for live. VT323 never leaves the ASCII field.

rules.name: The Flat-Field Rule
rules.body: Surfaces and chrome stay flat at rest. Depth is veil density or invert, never offset shadow.

rules.name: The Two-Clock Rule
rules.body: The veil drifts on a glacial clock. Hits acknowledge with 120ms color-only invert. Knob rotors never interpolate transform while dragging.

rules.name: The 1px Box Rule
rules.body: Hits are ink boxes. Do not thicken the stroke, and do not round the corners.

dos: Do isolate one control type per story, then treat Prism · Hold as another story.
Do let the veil drift slowly; acknowledge hits in 120ms color; keep rotor drag analog-instant.
Do draw hits as 1px ink boxes with 44px minimums on chips, pads, and steppers.
Do use moss invert for current story and latched pads.
donts: Don't restore HyperCard menus, ice desks, teal chips, phosphor-on-black terminals, or IBM Plex.
Don't use Teenage Engineering orange or treat --gxsc-fluoro as neon green.
Don't show Overlay on Knob, Slider, Pad, Stepper, or Nameplate.
Don't round rotors, pads, or chips, or add drop shadows.
Don't tick the ASCII field like a CRT.
Don't interpolate the knob rotor while dragging.
